conclusion: The init tool list is a build/catalog advertisement, not a trustworthy per-agent execution allowlist.
limits: This static inspection does not prove tool execution is disabled. Real job-local deny-hook evidence is required separately.
method: Locate Go pclntab names and function entries, then disassemble those exact PE addresses.
observations: buildInitPayload passes advertisedTools a boolean computed from a six-byte configuration string comparison (jetski).
advertisedTools reads a process-global tool-name map at 0x14c1c5788 and an optional static filter at 0x14c0d4d50/58.
No selected-agent tools value is passed to advertisedTools or read as a parameter in this function.
